fields.description: Primary key (autoname: format:{title}). Renaming creates a new row + orphans existing UnitContentItem references — choose a stable name. Template-variable hint: {student_name}, {week}, {archetype}, {course_level}, {path}, {escalation_order}, {escalation_type}, {language} — see status_template field.
fields.label: Title

fields.description: Script body delivered to Vocallabs as status_text. Supports {variable} substitution via _render_status_template. The script's spoken language follows from the script content itself; there is no separate language field on this doctype. The {language} variable expands to Student.language (the student's preferred language) — useful for templates that branch wording at runtime.
fields.label: Status Template

fields.description: Soft-disable flag. When 0, the resolver SKIPS this config and falls through (LU override → settings default → None). Lets ops retire a script without orphaning UnitContentItem or VoiceAgentSettings.default_parent_call_config references.
fields.label: Is Active

fields.description: Which VoiceNudgeConfig this template serves. When set, _resolve_parent_call_config falls back to this record when resolving by nudge type + language. Leave blank for templates used via LearningUnit attachment only.
fields.label: Nudge Type

fields.description: Language for this template variant. One ParentCallConfig per nudge_type + language combination. Leave blank for a language-agnostic fallback.
fields.label: Language
